jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description: About us Chamelio is revolutionizing legal tech with an AI-powered Legal Intelligence Platform trusted by some of the world's fastest-growing companies, including Wiz, Socure, Appsflyer and Monday. We help in-house legal teams accelerate negotiations, reduce risk, and unlock institutional knowledge through automated workflows. About the job We're looking for a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer to build intelligent backend infrastructure and exceptional user experiences that power our platform. You'll work directly with LLMs, design scalable systems, and ship production AI features that transform how legal teams operate worldwide. If you love owning features end-to-end and moving fast, we want to hear from you. What You'll Do - Own features end-to-end, from design through deployment across the full stack - Build scalable backend services and APIs using Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, Postgres, MongoDB) - Create responsive, performant frontend experiences with React.js - Develop integrations with enterprise platforms like Salesforce, Google Drive, SharePoint, and DocuSign - Work hands-on with LLMs and build the connecting logic between AI capabilities and business systems - Partner with ML engineers, AI researchers, and legal domain experts to deliver impactful solutions - Contribute to architectural decisions and help establish engineering best practices as we scale What You'll Bring - Passion to own and deliver – you take full responsibility for your work and drive features from idea to production - Curiosity and adoption of AI coding tools – you actively use tools like Cursor or Claude Code and are excited about how AI is transforming software development - 6+ years of professional experience building production systems across frontend and backend - Strong backend skills with Python and modern frameworks - Experience with React.js and building complex, performant UIs - Exceptional problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail - You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day work and are excited about their potential - Ability to quickly learn new technologies and thrive in unfamiliar domains - Strong communication skills, effective in a fast-paced startup environment Bonus Points - Experience building LLM-powered applications or working with AI APIs - Familiarity with AWS infrastructure and cloud-native architectures - Previously founded a startup or have early-stage startup experience Our Tech Stack Python, TypeScript, React.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Claude Code, Cursor Why Chamelio? - Make an impact: Your code will transform how legal teams at leading companies worldwide operate - Ship fast: Work in a lean, high-velocity environment where you see your work in production quickly - Own your work: Take full ownership of meaningful projects from conception to deployment - Grow with us: Join early and shape both the product and company as we scale

jobs.title: Applied AI Attorney
jobs.description: About us Chamelio is revolutionizing legal tech with an AI-powered Legal Intelligence Platform trusted by some of the world's fastest-growing companies, including Wiz, Socure, Appsflyer and Monday. We help in-house legal teams accelerate negotiations, reduce risk, and unlock institutional knowledge through automated workflows. About the job We're looking for an Applied AI Attorney to define what "good" means for our product - and then build it. Sitting inside our R&D team alongside AI engineers, you'll shape how our agents reason about legal work, decide how features should behave in the messy cases that matter, and turn years of legal judgment into systems that can reason, decide, and execute at scale. You'll become one of our customers. Every day you'll step into the shoes of an experienced in-house lawyer, recreating real commercial work, challenging the product with difficult negotiations, ambiguous requests, and unexpected edge cases, and helping transform those insights into product that legal teams trust. You're not reviewing outputs from the sidelines; you're deciding what the product should do and driving it there. If you're a practicing lawyer who'd rather build the system than use it, we'd love to hear from you. What You'll Do - Own the legal quality of the product - you set the bar our agents are held to and have the mandate to continuously raise it - Design the evaluation systems that prove we're getting it right, enabling the team to ship quickly with confidence - Define how features should behave: what great contract analysis looks like, which edge cases matter, where the product should push back instead of guessing, and how an exceptional in-house lawyer would approach the problem - Act as one of our customers by recreating real legal workflows, testing complex scenarios, and uncovering edge cases before they reach production - Work hands-on with prompts, agent instructions, and workflow design alongside our AI engineers - Diagnose why an output fell short - weak retrieval, incorrect reasoning, missing context, or flawed workflow design - and drive the solution with the engineers who own it - Bring real legal work into the product by creating the scenarios, datasets, and reference material our agents are built and evaluated against - Influence the product roadmap with a practitioner's perspective on where legal teams actually lose time, introduce risk, and need better automation - Partner closely with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to continuously improve how our AI systems perform in the real world What You'll Bring - 5-10 years of legal experience, preferably as in-house counsel in a high-growth B2B SaaS company - Licensed to practice law, with substantive depth in commercial contracts, transactional work, privacy, compliance, or regulatory counseling - Passion to own and deliver - you take full responsibility for the quality of what ships and drive problems from symptom to resolution - Curiosity and adoption of AI tools - you already use LLMs in your legal work and have strong opinions about where they succeed and where they break - Product instincts - you can translate legal judgment into clear product behavior, evaluation criteria, and specifications that engineers can build against - Comfort with ambiguity and unfamiliar technical territory, with the ability to learn quickly - Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate directly with engineers in a fast-paced startup environment Bonus Points - Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG, or agentic workflows - Previous product experience, or having built internal tooling as a lawyer - Early-stage startup experience - In-house legal experience Why Chamelio? - Make an impact: The quality bar you set becomes the one legal teams at leading companies rely on every day - Ship fast: Work in a lean, high-velocity environment where you see your work in production quickly - Own your work: Take full ownership of meaningful projects from conception to deployment - Grow with us: Join early and shape both the product and company as we scale

jobs.title: Lead Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: LEAD CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a Lead Customer Success Manager to own and scale customer success for Chamelio’s active customer base. This is a senior, customer-facing role focused on helping in-house legal teams get sustained value from Chamelio after implementation. You’ll work with stable accounts to track engagement, deepen adoption, educate users on AI-enabled legal workflows, and make sure customers continue to see Chamelio as an essential part of how their legal teams operate. You’ll partner closely with Account Management, which owns the commercial relationship, while you own customer engagement, health, education, and long-term value realization. You’ll also help build the customer success function itself: defining playbooks, engagement programs, customer health signals, education motions, and eventually helping grow and lead the team. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT & ADOPTION - Own ongoing success for Chamelio’s active customer accounts after onboarding - Track product engagement, usage patterns, customer sentiment, and account health - Identify risks early and proactively drive plans to increase adoption and value - Build strong relationships with legal, legal operations, and business stakeholders - Help customers expand usage across teams, workflows, departments, and regions - Run regular customer check-ins focused on adoption, impact, education, and next best actions - Turn passive or under-engaged accounts into active, confident, high-value users AI EDUCATION & ENABLEMENT - Educate customers on how to use AI effectively, responsibly, and practically in legal workflows - Help in-house legal teams understand what Chamelio can do, where it fits, and how to build confidence in AI-assisted work - Create repeatable enablement programs, training sessions, office hours, and customer education materials - Translate customer uncertainty or friction around AI into clear guidance, examples, and product feedback - Stay current on legal AI, legal operations, and customer adoption patterns so Chamelio’s customers are always learning from best practices CUSTOMER SUCCESS OPERATIONS - Build the operating rhythm for customer success at Chamelio - Define customer health metrics, engagement thresholds, risk indicators, and reporting - Create playbooks for account reviews, adoption campaigns, customer education, executive updates, and risk recovery - Segment customers by needs, maturity, and engagement level to design the right success motions - Partner with Product to share structured customer feedback and identify recurring needs - Partner with Account Management on renewal readiness, expansion signals, and customer risk, while leaving commercial ownership with the Account Management team TEAM BUILDING - Help define what excellent customer success looks like at Chamelio - Build the systems, habits, and standards that future customer success team members will follow - Mentor future hires and help grow the customer success function over time - Bring structure without slowing the company down: practical process, clear ownership, and strong customer judgment WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 5–10 years of experience in customer success, account management, customer education, implementation, solutions consulting, or a similar customer-facing B2B SaaS role - Experience managing ongoing relationships with mid-market or enterprise customers - Strong ability to drive adoption and engagement across complex organizations - Experience building customer success playbooks, health scoring, engagement programs, or education motions - Excellent communication skills, including comfort presenting to senior stakeholders - Strong technical curiosity and comfort explaining AI or complex software to non-technical users - Ability to partner well with Account Management, Sales, Product, and Engineering - Structured thinking, high ownership, and a proactive approach to customer risk - Startup mindset: practical, accountable, adaptable, and comfortable building from ambiguity STRONG PLUS - Experience working with legal teams, legal operations, contract workflows, or legal tech - Familiarity with AI products, knowledge management, CLM, matter management, or workflow automation - Experience creating customer education programs, webinars, workshops, help content, or community-style enablement - Experience as an early customer success hire or as part of a fast-growing CS organization WHY JOIN CHAMELIO Chamelio is building legal intelligence for modern in-house legal teams. Our customers use Chamelio to structure legal knowledge, improve legal workflows, and bring AI into the daily work of legal teams in a practical, trusted way. In this role, you’ll shape how customers continue to learn, engage, and grow with Chamelio over time. You’ll be close to customers, close to product, and close to leadership, with real influence over how the customer success function is built. If you want to help legal teams adopt AI meaningfully, build a high-impact CS motion, and grow into a leadership role without stepping away from the customer, we’d love to meet you. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Chamelio is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive, thoughtful, and ambitious team.
